scenario_interpretation: Analyst-defined adverse, base and favorable assumptions. These are not probability bounds, calibrated prediction intervals, management guidance or price targets. Outcomes can fall outside the range.
limits: A within-quarter fundamental forecast with no realized target-quarter outcome.
The forecast does not constitute full valuation, governance, cash-conversion or position-sizing underwriting.
Seasonal anchors use one prior year and can break when business mix changes.
rationale: Separate manufacturing EBIT, recognized government incentives, other income and after-tax joint-venture contribution. Strong Q2 revenue does not justify extrapolating every income component at the same growth rate. The base allows modest manufacturing growth while normalizing other income.

verified_facts.fact: Q2 operating revenue 823.4240cr includes government incentive 29.7959cr. Q1 incentive was 34.26cr and prior Q2 incentive 35.50cr.
Q2 other income 5.2561cr, finance cost 10.9974cr, own PBT before joint venture 41.6006cr, after-tax joint-venture contribution 1.1115cr, tax 10.7011cr and owner PAT 32.0110cr.
Prior Q3 consolidated labour-code exceptional charge was 6.5323cr. The standalone charge of 6.4005cr is a different accounting scope.
The issuer moved to the lower tax regime from April 2026. A prior March 2026 deferred-tax remeasurement is not treated as a repeating quarterly gain.

derived_facts.label: Q2 manufacturing EBIT excluding government incentives and other income

assumptions.label: Manufacturing EBIT
assumptions.basis: Revenue above Q2 ex-incentive 793.6281cr and margin moderately above derived 2.21 percent. These are judgmental assumptions, not company guidance.

assumptions.label: Government incentive
assumptions.basis: Near Q2 recognition, below Q1 and prior-year quarters. Timing and eligibility remain uncertain.

assumptions.label: Other income and financing
assumptions.basis: Do not repeat the full Q2 other-income increase.

assumptions.label: Tax and joint venture
assumptions.base: 25.17 percent tax on own PBT, then 1cr JV profit
assumptions.basis: Approximation to the new tax regime. JV profit is already after tax and is not taxed twice.

disconfirming_evidence_to_watch: Government incentive recognition below 22cr or delayed recognition would undermine the downside case.
Other income remaining above 5cr would make the base conservative.
Manufacturing volume growth without margin improvement would reduce the value of the revenue increase.
main_takeaway: Government incentive timing and tax regime are essential to interpreting the reported earnings growth.
